tests.notes: confirms external function types are represented as an (address, 4-byte selector) pair, unlike internal function types' opaque code pointer
contrast with internal_function_type/007's expected-fail: external function types ARE ABI-encodable and can appear in public/external signatures
reading .address/.selector on an unset external function type is always safe -- defaults to (address(0), 0x00000000)

compiles successfully; calling an unset external function type is a plain low-level call to address(0), NOT a Solidity Panic code -- distinct failure mechanism from internal function types' Panic(0x51)
external function types also support == directly, comparing both address and selector components together
